subject: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holden <sara.holden@nimblepay.com>, Victor Chang <victor.chang@nimblepay.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play

Hi Sara / Victor,

Hope you both had a great week. As we approach the renewal conversation later this month, the commercial team is putting together a short outcomes pack that highlights a couple of customer wins to support the expansion discussion. NimblePay is top of mind because the performance gains from the October model migration have been material for your team.

Would NimblePay be willing to: 
1) Provide a brief 1-2 sentence quote we can use in a one-page case highlight, and
2) Approve use of the NimblePay logo and the high-level outcomes (latency reduction and cost delta) in marketing and renewal materials?

Attached: nimblepay-qtr2-outcomes.pdf (summary of metrics) and a mutual-action-plan.xlsx with suggested timelines for the expansion. We only plan to show aggregated metrics (no PII) — sample numbers are called out in the PDF. If you prefer a draft quote, I can send one for edit. Timeline: aiming to publish an internal-facing one-pager by Aug 18 (so sign-off by Aug 10 would be ideal).

If useful I can loop in Marissa from CS to confirm the numbers and Stephanie from legal for logo/legal wording.

Thanks — appreciate you considering this.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- nimblepay-qtr2-outcomes.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Sara Holden <sara.holden@nimblepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Chang <victor.chang@nimblepay.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play

Jonas — thanks for the note and congrats to the team on the smooth migration. In principle were happy to support a short customer highlight for the renewal. A couple of quick asks before we sign off: 

- Can you share a one-line draft quote we can approve/edit? That will speed things up on our end.
- Legal needs to sign off on logo usage and any phrasing that mentions revenue impact. Can you have Redwoods legal/marketing include proposed logo usage and a copy of the one-pager?

Also cc'ing Victor from procurement; he generally handles any formal marketing approvals for references.

High level: the team is comfortable with sharing anonymized metrics (latency down ~45% and per-transaction inference cost down ~38% vs prior endpoint). Wed prefer to avoid disclosing ARR lift numbers publicly, but a directional statement on conversion uplift should be OK if its framed as "NimblePay reported improved checkout conversion after faster model responses."

If you can get the draft to us by EOD Aug 6 well try to review and respond by Aug 10.

Thanks,
Sara Holden
Head of Product Operations, NimblePay
Sara.Holden@nimblepay.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holden <sara.holden@nimblepay.com>, Victor Chang <victor.chang@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play

Thanks, Sara — really appreciate the quick reply and the guidance on legal. Attached is a very short draft (two options) you can pick from or edit. Also attached is the one-pager draft (drive link in the metadata above) that shows the exact phrasing were planning to use. Per your note Ive removed any explicit ARR figures and kept the conversion impact directional.

Draft quote options (pick or edit):
- Option A: "Redwoods inference platform reduced our model latency by ~45% and cut per-transaction inference cost by ~38%, enabling faster checkouts and better conversion velocity."
- Option B: "With Redwood, we saw significantly faster model responses and lower inference cost, which helped improve checkout performance and customer experience."

Proposed publication scope: one internal-facing slide and a short paragraph in our renewal materials + a one-line customer quote on the public case study page. If there are any elements you want redacted (logo usage, metric wording), tell us exactly what to remove.

Marissa, can you confirm the numbers in the attached PDF are the final QA'd metrics? Stephanie, can your team coordinate a short legal permission note we can route to NimblePay legal if needed?

Next steps: if Sara/Victor reply with the preferred quote and logo approval by Aug 10 well mark the one-pager as approved for the Aug 18 internal publish.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- nimblepay-case-draft-v1.docx (docx, 34KB)
- nimblepay-qtr2-outcomes.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Victor Chang <victor.chang@nimblepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sara Holden <sara.holden@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblepay.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play

Jonas / Sara — procurement here. A few items we need before formal approval: 

1) Confirmation that no customer PII or transaction-level data will be published. High-level aggregate metrics only are fine.
2) A short legal release that NimblePay can sign (one paragraph, includes logo usage rights and a non-confidentiality assertion).
3) If Redwoods draft mentions any revenue or conversion percentages, NimblePays legal wants discretion to request redaction. 

If Redwood can produce the legal release text (and copy Stephanie on coordination) we can circulate internally and aim to sign off by Aug 10. Procurement will take care of the official signature.

Thanks,
Victor Chang
Senior Procurement Manager, NimblePay
victor.chang@nimblepay.com

From: Sara Holden <sara.holden@nimblepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Chang <victor.chang@nimblepay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Permission to use NimblePay outcomes + short quote for renewal play

Jonas — thanks for the patience. NimblePay approves the following: 

- Approved quote (short): "Redwood's inference platform reduced our model latency by ~45% and lowered per-transaction inference cost by ~38%, helping improve checkout performance."
- Logo: attached high-res nimblepay-logo.png (provided for approved use).
- Metrics: approval to publish the aggregate latency and cost percentages included in nimblepay-qtr2-outcomes.pdf. Please remove the sentence that references ARR uplift; keep conversion language generic ("improve checkout performance").

Victor: procurement has reviewed and will sign the release once Redwood shares the one-paragraph legal release. Stephanie, please see procurement's ask from Aug 6 and loop in your legal counsel for the release text.

I attached a short approved-quote.txt file with the exact wording above — feel free to use verbatim. Appreciate the team coordinating this.

Best,
Sara Holden
Head of Product Operations, NimblePay

Attachments:
- nimblepay-logo.png (png, 85KB)
- approved-quote.txt (txt, 240B)
